title.value: Advocacy for Children With Surgical Diseases in Nigeria: National Policy Status, Gaps, and Solutions
title.justification: The title of the paper is explicitly mentioned in the initial section of the document.
title.quote: Advocacy for Children With Surgical Diseases in Nigeria: National Policy Status, Gaps, and Solutions

analysis.description: The paper analyzes the status of children's surgery within Nigeria's healthcare policies, evaluates gaps and provides solutions for better coverage of surgical needs for children in national health strategies.

type.justification: The paper evaluates real-world policy documents and their impact on children's surgical care, thus making it an empirical study.
type.quote: Seven policy documents with child and adolescent health contents were reviewed: the National Child Health Policy (NCHP),...

name.justification: The research focuses on healthcare policy as it analyzes the inclusion of children's surgery in Nigeria's health policies.
name.quote: The search for evidence (3rd step in Colin’s framework) included a combination of directed (DCA) and conventional content analysis (CCA).

name.justification: The paper's focus is on surgical diseases affecting children in Nigeria.
name.quote: There is limited prioritization of children's surgery in Nigeria's healthcare policies that address varying aspects of child and adolescent health.
